judged_text: removeMember and addMembers attach only a .then handler with no .catch, and the reload inside .then (self.findMembers()) is not returned, so every failure in the mutation chain — the DELETE/PUT itself or the follow-up reload — is an unhandled rejection. An admin who clicks the remove (×) icon or Add and the request fails (422 for automatic groups via API race, 404, 500) sees the bootbox confirm succeed and then nothing happens: no error message, member list unchanged, failure completely invisible; the controller's addMembers/removeMember actions (admin-group.js.es6 lines 51-65) also discard the returned promise, so even a caller-level catch would not help.

adjudication.rationale: Diff introduces Group#addMembers and #removeMember that return `Discourse.ajax(...).then(function(){ self.findMembers(); })` but do not `return self.findMembers()` from the `.then`, so the follow-up reload is not part of the promise chain and any reload failure can’t be observed/handled (app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js). Additionally, the admin controller actions don’t return the mutation promises: `removeMember` calls `self.get("model").removeMember(member);` inside the bootbox callback without returning it, and `addMembers` calls `this.get("model").addMembers(...)` without returning it (admin-group.js.es6). There is also no `.catch` anywhere in these flows, so failed PUT/DELETE (422/404/500) yields no user-visible error and any rejection is left unhandled by this code path.
